introduction.text: In this Unit 5 Review, you will revisit vocabulary and grammar related to shopping and navigating around town. You will practice using simple phrases and sentences to communicate effectively in everyday situations.
introduction.culturalNote: Shopping culture in Spanish-speaking countries often includes vibrant markets and street vendors, where you can find unique local products.

vocabulary.definition: A place where you buy goods.

exampleSentence.translation: I am going to the store.

vocabulary.tip: Remember that 'la' is used for feminine nouns.
Remember to use 'la' for feminine nouns.

vocabulary.definition: Used to ask for a location.

vocabulary.tip: Adjectives in Spanish agree in gender and number with nouns.

grammar.title: Using 'ser' and 'estar'
grammar.explanation: 'Ser' and 'estar' both mean 'to be' in Spanish, but they are used in different contexts. 'Ser' is used for permanent characteristics and identities, while 'estar' is used for temporary states and locations.
commonMistakes: Using 'ser' for location instead of 'estar'. Correct: 'Estoy en casa.'
Using 'estar' for permanent traits. Correct: 'Él es médico.'

dialogue.title: Shopping at the Market
dialogue.context: A conversation between two friends at a local market.

lines.text: Hola, Luis. ¿Dónde está la tienda de frutas?
lines.translation: Hello, Luis. Where is the fruit store?

lines.text: Hola, Ana. La tienda está cerca de aquí.
lines.translation: Hello, Ana. The store is close to here.

lines.text: Perfecto. Tengo un poco de dinero.
lines.translation: Perfect. I have a little money.
What kind of fruit do you want?

lines.text: Muy bien. Aquí está la tienda.
lines.translation: Very good. Here is the store.

culture.title: Shopping in Latin America
culture.text: Shopping in Latin America often involves visiting vibrant local markets. These markets are not only places to buy food, but also to socialize and experience local culture.
culture.funFact: In many Latin American countries, haggling is a common practice in markets, so don't be afraid to negotiate prices!

keyPoints: Review of vocabulary related to shopping
summary.nextSteps: Continue practicing vocabulary and try to create your own dialogues about shopping scenarios.
